name: Stream Stats
description: Per-provider numbers from what viewers actually did: streams checked, knocked down and skipped, how often each provider ranks first, top 3 and top 5, and the good streams it brings as well as its failure rate. Read only: it changes nothing and never opens a stream.
author: Kurrt

fields.label: Rescue counts after (seconds)
fields.help_text: A failover onto a stream counts as a rescue once it holds this long.

fields.label: Unproven below (tries)
fields.help_text: A provider with fewer tries is marked unproven.

fields.label: Solid above (tries)
fields.help_text: A provider with at least this many tries is marked solid.

fields.label: Data: unproven below (streams)
fields.help_text: So many tries of a few streams don't look like proof about a whole provider.

actions.label: Event handler
actions.description: Runs by itself on these events. The button does nothing.

actions.label: Write report
actions.description: Writes an HTML page, a CSV and a JSON file.

actions.label: Save today's order now
actions.description: Happens by itself once a day. Use this the first time so tomorrow has something to compare with.

confirm.title: Erase all collected numbers?
confirm.message: This can't be undone. Nothing in Dispatcharr itself changes.
